$description: Halderworks Instrument, papertrace brand, brand papertrace. Generated by tools/export.py to the Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10. A colour carries its value in every mode under $extensions.halderworks.modes, and $value is light; a size or duration that a density, the touch floor or reduced motion moves carries those values under $extensions.halderworks.conditions.

bg.$description: the page ground behind every surface

surface.$description: the page a reader works on

fill-hover.$description: a quiet control under the pointer

on-ink.$description: the label on an ink solid

ink-hover.$description: the ink solid under the pointer

accent.$description: a solid: brand button, selected switch

accent-hover.$description: the accent solid under the pointer

on-accent.$description: the label on an accent solid

accent-line.$description: the edge of a selected row or chip

mark-quiet.$description: a quiet highlight behind running text

success-fill.$description: behind a success callout or badge

success-line.$description: the edge of a success callout

warning-fill.$description: behind a warning callout or badge

warning-line.$description: the edge of a warning callout

danger-fill.$description: behind an error callout or badge

danger-line.$description: the edge of an error callout or field

danger-hover.$description: the destructive solid under the pointer

on-danger.$description: the label on a destructive solid

scrim.$description: behind a modal dialog; never read on

text-lg.$description: 17: lead, row title in a reading view

control-h-sm.$description: 24: a compact control; never under the 2.5.8 target

control-h-lg.$description: 40: one call to action on a marketing surface

textSize.$description: the text-size setting: the root size at the browser's default 16px, set by html[data-text-size]

radius-sm.$description: Things inside other things: badges, checkboxes, swatches, the status dot.

radius-md.$description: Interactive controls: buttons, inputs, selects, menu items, tabs.

radius-lg.$description: Containers: cards, panels, dialogs, popovers, toasts.

radius-full.$description: Avatars and count pills only, where the shape itself carries the meaning.

shadow-overlay.$description: Popovers, menus and toasts in light theme. Dark theme carries elevation by surface lightness instead.

shadow-dialog.$description: Dialogs and sheets in light theme, the only element allowed a shadow this large, and a menu-bar panel in both themes (36-form-factors.md).

bp-sm.$description: Phone to small tablet. Below it a screen is one column and the rail is a sheet.

bp-md.$description: The measured consensus edge: 23 of 44 captured sites declare a 768px min-width, more than any other value.

bp-lg.$description: Second most declared, on 18 of 44. The rail becomes permanent here.

bp-xl.$description: Declared on 12 of 44. The content column stops growing; the margins take the rest.

bp-2xl.$description: Only a wide table or a three-pane shell uses the extra width. Prose never does.

gutter-sm.$description: Page margin below hw-bp-md. Measured at 390px wide: 16px on 6 of 12 sites, 24px on 3.

gutter-md.$description: Page margin from hw-bp-md to hw-bp-lg.

gutter-lg.$description: Page margin at hw-bp-lg and above.

column-gap.$description: The gutter between grid columns. 24px is the fourth most used column-gap in the capture (93 uses) and the largest that stays on the 4px grid at every step.

columns.$description: Twelve columns above hw-bp-lg, six from hw-bp-md, four below. 58 of the grids sampled use twelve.

container-app.$description: The app shell's cap. Past it the content pane stops and the window grows around it.

container-page.$description: Marketing and documentation. The 1100-1300 band is the most occupied in the capture: 20 of 44 sites.

container-prose.$description: A reading column on its own. The median measured prose column at 1440px across the capture is 721px.

measure-prose.$description: Long-form. The median measured running-text width across 30 sites is 64ch; 68ch sits inside the comfortable band and above the product step.

rail.$description: The app shell's navigation rail at hw-bp-lg and above.

rail-collapsed.$description: The rail reduced to icons, which is the only collapsed state it has.

panel-w.$description: A menu-bar utility panel. 40ch of body-sm Public Sans measures 318.4px with the face loaded, plus hw-cell-pad-x each side, rounded up to the 4px grid.

panel-max-h.$description: A menu-bar panel's ceiling: a 32px header, 12 rows at hw-row-h-compact and a 48px footer. Always clamped further by min(, calc(100vh - hw-space-48)).

icon-sm.$description: Inside a badge or beside 12px label text.

icon.$description: The default. 16x16 is the most widely used rendered icon size in the capture: 21 of 44 sites.

icon-lg.$description: A toolbar or rail icon that carries its own hit target.

icon-stroke.$description: Stroke weight at 16px and 20px. 1.5px on 8 sites, 2px on 12; 1.5px is the lighter of the two and the one that survives beside 13px text.

icon-gap.$description: Icon to its own label. Below the 4px grid on purpose: 4px reads as one object, 8px as two.

z-sticky.$description: A sticky table head or a pinned toolbar.

z-rail.$description: The app shell's rail when it overlays content below hw-bp-lg.

z-toast.$description: Toasts, which must clear a dialog because they report what the dialog did.

border-w.$description: Every border in the system. There is no 2px border.

focus-w.$description: The focus ring. 2px is the most used real outline-width in the capture: 246 declarations against 75 at 1px.

focus-offset.$description: The gap between the control's own edge and its ring, so the ring reads as a ring.

tab-active-w.$description: The rule under the selected tab, which is the one place a 2px line is a state.
